name: IL1RL1 / ST2
technical_accuracy_of_explore_claim: PARTIALLY_REFUTED_BULK_RESCUED_SINGLE_CELL_SPATIAL: Paired Prudencio GSE67196 Frontal-minus-Cerebellar interaction is null (DESeq2 log2FC=-0.3218, p=0.6595, padj=0.9998; OLS beta=+0.0366, p=0.9692), NYGC bulk regions/ALS-Glia are diluted to null (Frontal M2 +0.0297, p=0.9133; Cervical M2 -0.3049, p=0.3160; ALS-Glia cortex n=67 beta=+0.2164, p=0.6510; cord n=167 beta=+0.2874, p=0.3062), and Trautwig/Oh MS detect 0 proteins (pg/mL ceiling), BUT Edinburgh snRNA-seq proves IL1RL1 is vascular-endothelial-restricted (beta=+3.1571, p=0.0211; non-C9 sALS +3.5877, p=0.00698) and Zhang cervical spatial confirms +3.7606 log2FC (bh_fdr=1.85e-09) in anterior horn MN niches.
causal_vs_reactive_assessment: AMBIGUOUS_ISOFORM_DEPENDENT: Proximal-promoter soluble sST2 secreted by inflamed CNS endothelium acts as a pathogenic decoy sink sequestering astrocytic IL-33 (6.10 log2CPM) away from neuroprotective ST2L+ Tregs/microglia, whereas distal-promoter transmembrane ST2L is protective — pan-ST2 blockade risks wrong-sign Treg suppression unless sST2-selective.
prior_art_crowding_level: LOW_IN_ALS_MODERATE_PERIPHERAL (8 peripheral astegolimab COPD/asthma/AD trials; 0 ALS or CNS clinical trials)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Donor-level Edinburgh snRNA-seq (>8-fold cortical endothelial IL1RL1 induction in ALS, non-C9 sALS p=0.00698; astrocytic IL33=6.10 log2CPM), Zhang 2026 spatial anterior horn MN-niche upregulation (+3.7606 log2FC, bh_fdr=1.85e-09), and AlphaGenome proof that rs1420101 alters arterial/endothelial IL1RL1 splice junctions (quantile=0.9966) while rs953934 drives opposite expression in endothelial (-0.9958) vs CD4+ T cells (+0.9906).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Bulk postmortem cortex/cord homogenates fail to detect differential expression due to <1% endothelial dilution, and short-read/MS datasets cannot verify whether the ALS endothelial surge is soluble decoy sST2 vs membrane ST2L.
factual_justification: Bulk transcriptomic nulls reflect severe cellular dilution of a <1% vascular-endothelial transcript rather than absence of biology, and shotgun CSF MS lacks pg/mL sensitivity for soluble ST2. Because donor-level snRNA-seq and cervical spatial transcriptomics independently confirm strong ALS neurovascular IL1RL1 induction and no CNS/isoform-selective sST2 intervention has ever been tested, Epistemic Asymmetry mandates KEEP_EXPLORATORY_UNPROVEN.
discriminating_next_test: Perform 5'-promoter/splice-junction-resolved long-read or ddPCR quantification of soluble sST2 (proximal promoter/intron-8 polyA) vs transmembrane ST2L (distal promoter) in ALS motor-cortex/anterior-horn microvessels plus Simoa/ELISA quantification of paired ALS CSF free IL-33 and sST2; advance only an isoform-selective sST2-neutralizing biologic that spares Treg ST2L signaling.

name: CHIT1 / GPNMB / CHI3L1-CHI3L2 microglial chitinase-lysosomal phenoconversion axis
technical_accuracy_of_explore_claim: VERIFIED_QUANTITATIVELY: Re-computation in Trautwig 4-center CSF DIA (total N=259: Emory 118, MGH 78, WashU 32, UMilan 31; sALS n=50 vs Ctrl n=72) & Emory TMT (N=101) and Oh 2023 confirms symptomatic-only elevation across all 4 purple-module proteins (CHIT1 q=3.24e-09, BatchOLS +1.7955, p=2.51e-08; CHI3L2 q=2.29e-09; CHI3L1 q=8.04e-04; GPNMB q=0.00162, BatchOLS +0.3328, p=0.00480), with complete absence in pre-symptomatic C9orf72/SOD1 carriers (p=0.2937-0.9918). NYGC Cervical M3 cell-comp OLS (n=198) confirms CHIT1 (+2.4285, p=1.62e-10) and GPNMB (+2.2014, p=1.90e-18) reflect true DAM induction, whereas CHI3L1 (+0.0876, p=0.7517) and CHI3L2 (+0.3345, p=0.1769) track reactive gliosis.
causal_vs_reactive_assessment: REACTIVE_BIOMARKER_AND_COMPENSATORY_PROTECTIVE: Human germline CHIT1 knockout (24-bp exon-10 duplication rs3831317, AF=0.2200, 40,441 gnomAD homozygotes) does not protect against ALS risk or slow progression; GPNMB (#1 PD 7p15 L2G=0.492) is neuroprotective/pro-lysosomal in TDP-43/SOD1 models so inhibition inverts the therapeutic sign; CHI3L1/CHI3L2 are non-catalytic pseudochitinases (CHI3L2 lacks a mouse ortholog).
prior_art_crowding_level: VERY_HIGH_BIOMARKER_BENCHMARK (established CSF chitinase/GPNMB ALS staging & PIKfyve PD biomarker panel; OATD-01 tested only in pulmonary sarcoidosis NCT06205121)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Air-tight replication across Trautwig TMT/DIA, Oh 2023 CSF, NYGC spinal cord, Edinburgh snRNA-seq, and Zhang TDP-43+ spatial niches establishes the 4-protein panel as a premier phenoconversion, ALS-Glia stratification, and lysosomal target-engagement biomarker suite.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Natural human CHIT1 null homozygosity (rs3831317) fails to confer ALS protection or survival benefit, GPNMB loss/inhibition exacerbates motor-neuron stress (wrong sign for inhibition), and CHI3L1/CHI3L2 lack catalytic activity.
factual_justification: All four sub-nodes (C017-N1..N4) replicate strongly as symptomatic phenoconversion and glial/lysosomal fluid biomarkers (completely flat in pre-symptomatic C9/SOD1 carriers), but fail Track B drug-target criteria: human genetic CHIT1 deficiency (rs3831317) does not alter ALS risk/progression, GPNMB is compensatory/neuroprotective (wrong sign for inhibition), and CHI3L1/CHI3L2 are catalytically inactive pseudochitinases.
discriminating_next_test: Deploy rs3831317-genotype-adjusted CSF CHIT1 + GPNMB + CHI3L1/CHI3L2 as a quantitative phenoconversion and ALS-Glia / lysosomal pharmacodynamic biomarker panel in Track A/B trials rather than pursuing chitinase/GPNMB inhibition.

name: C1QA-C1QC / C3 / C4B classical and alternative complement cascade
technical_accuracy_of_explore_claim: SUBSTANTIALLY_OVERSTATED_IN_BULK_AND_CSF: In Emory TMT (N=101: 35 vs 44), all 5 proteins are null (p=0.2701-0.8189). In 4-center DIA (total N=259: Emory 118, MGH 78, WashU 32, UMilan 31; sALS n=50 vs Ctrl n=72; WashU/UMilan contributed 63 ALS and 0 Controls), C1QA (diff=+0.1414, q=0.1472; CovOLS p=0.2361), C1QC (sALS p=0.2762; C9-Asym diff=+0.1155, p=0.0371 -> q=0.2583), C3 (diff=+0.1790, q=0.0708; BatchOLS p=0.0528), and C4B (diff=+0.1749, p=0.0568, q=0.3369) fail BH-FDR/center audits, leaving marginal C1QB (diff=+0.1721, q=0.0358). NYGC Cervical bulk increases collapse in M3 (p=0.0881-0.5583), while Zhang 6i_TDP43 confirms focal enrichment for C1QA (+0.9733, bh_fdr=7.36e-06), C1QB (+1.2965, bh_fdr=1.24e-05), C1QC (+1.1986, bh_fdr=7.60e-09), and C3 (+1.2920, bh_fdr=5.82e-23) with C4B=NOT_IN_TABLE.
causal_vs_reactive_assessment: SPLIT_BY_SUBNODE: Systemic C3 (C018-N4) is clinically falsified (MERIDIAN NCT04579666) and C4B (C018-N5) is a center/composition/CNV passenger; CNS parenchymal C1q (C018-N1..N3) mediates C3-independent neuronal endocytosis and RNA-dependent LLPS into neuronal RNP/polysome complexes (Scott-Hewitt et al., Cell 2024, 10.1016/j.cell.2024.05.058 + LRP1/CALR) never tested in an RCT (ANX005 NCT04569435 was single-arm IV N=17), but faces a wrong-sign gate from Lobsiger et al. (PNAS 2013, PMID:24145411) where C1qa KO worsened motor-neuron cholinergic C-bouton loss in SOD1 mice.
prior_art_crowding_level: HIGH_SYSTEMIC_COMPLEMENT_FAILURES (SC pegcetacoplan C3 NCT04579666, ravulizumab C5 NCT04248465, zilucoplan C5 NCT04436497 all failed; IV ANX005 C1q NCT04569435 completed open-label Ph2a N=17 only; 0 CNS-restricted anti-C1q ALS RCTs)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Zhang 2026 6i_TDP43_ALS_vs._HC spinal spatial spots show focal C1QA/B/C upregulation (C1QA +0.9733 [bh_fdr=7.36e-06], C1QB +1.2965 [bh_fdr=1.24e-05], C1QC +1.1986 [bh_fdr=7.60e-09]), and Scott-Hewitt et al. (Cell 2024, 10.1016/j.cell.2024.05.058) establishes C3-independent neuronal C1q uptake into RNP complexes/polysomes.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Phase 2 MERIDIAN (NCT04579666, SC pegcetacoplan C3, N=249) terminated for Week 52 CAFS & secondary futility alongside C5 failures; bulk cord RNA and CSF shifts largely reflect microglial proportion/center confounding; systemic C1Q ablation carries >90% SLE/encapsulated-sepsis liability (61.1-72.2/100); and C1qa KO in SOD1 mice exacerbated motor-neuron C-bouton loss (Lobsiger et al., PNAS 2013, PMID:24145411).
factual_justification: Sub-node dissection drops C3 (C018-N4, FALSIFIED_CLINICAL in Phase 2 MERIDIAN) and C4B (C018-N5, ARTIFACT_CONFOUNDED). Per Epistemic Asymmetry, CNS parenchymal C1q (C018-N1..N3) was NOT falsified by MERIDIAN for two independent reasons: (a) SC pegcetacoplan (~43.5 kDa, <0.1% intact-BBB entry, Liver C3=1575.28 TPM sink) could not test spinal anterior-horn parenchyma, and (b) neuronal C1q endocytosis and RNA-dependent LLPS into RNP/polysome complexes plus LRP1/CALR signaling act independently of C3 cleavage (Scott-Hewitt et al., Cell 2024, 10.1016/j.cell.2024.05.058). However, systemic IV ANX005 (~150 kDa IgG4, <0.3% CSF entry + >90% SLE/sepsis systemic liability) is rejected in favor of CNS-compartment-restricted delivery (intrathecal anti-C1q Fab [ANX007 precedent] or BBB-shuttled binder sparing peripheral C1q).
discriminating_next_test: Do NOT advance C3, C4B, or systemic IV ANX005. First clear the mandatory Lobsiger et al. (PNAS 2013, PMID:24145411) wrong-sign safety gate by testing CNS-restricted C1q blockade (intrathecal anti-C1q Fab [ANX007 precedent] or BBB-shuttled binder sparing peripheral C1q) in non-SOD1 TDP-43 models co-measuring motor-neuron cholinergic C-bouton preservation and neuronal C1q-RNP translation (Scott-Hewitt 2024); advance to a biomarker-stratified ALS Phase 2 RCT only if both C-boutons and RNP proteostasis are preserved/rescued with >90% free CSF C1q suppression.
